correctness.rationale: All 59,049 labelled configurations and both fully specified successor maps are enumerated by exact integer arithmetic. Kahn indegree peeling with reverse assignment proves full entry-time and least-period labels, and an independent C++ implementation applies Floyd cycle-finding separately to all 59,049 states, reproducing every entry of both tables and the pointwise period agreement. The common 30,240 three-cycle configurations are checked statewise for equal successors and the contact-at-all-vertices condition. The full automorphism group is S5 by intrinsic maximal four-cliques; all 120 induced actions are verified and all 10,080 temporal-three orbits are partitioned into 118 spatial orbits with size distribution 2x15+3x20+7x30+49x60+57x120. Executing python3 verification/check_all.py from actual package paths passed. No finite sample is used to prove an infinite claim.

originality.rationale: The new object is T(5)=J(5,2)=the complement of the Petersen graph, not the published Petersen graph itself. The closest inspected Petersen CCA/GHM joint census gives 4800 period mismatches on its graph, and does not imply the complementary-graph pointwise matching and 118 common temporal-cycle symmetry types. The published biclique pointwise equality is limited to complete bipartite graphs; T(5) contains triangles. KG(6,2) is a distinct 15-vertex disjointness graph. Gravner–Lyu–Sivakoff Theorem 3 gives conservative-1-form synchronization and activity, not the exact full first-entry and spatial class tables. No exact covering record was found in targeted published-finding corpus, own claim and literature checks; residual unindexed historical priority risk is acknowledged.
residual_risks: An unindexed earlier computational database could contain the same finite T(5) table.

value.rationale: T(5) is the canonical 10-vertex triangular Johnson graph, complementary to the Petersen graph, whose 4800 CCA/GHM period mismatches were already classified. Finding exact pointwise agreement of eventual periods on this canonical complement while preserving identical 10080 temporal-three wave orbits but different sharp relaxation depths, and resolving these orbits into 118 intrinsic S5 classes, is a natural complete finite dynamical classification and nontrivial comparative boundary of the period-coincidence phenomenon. It is not a routine substitution: every one of the 59049 states and all 120 spatial actions must be checked.
